notes: Partition verified: 17 source / 23 target, each used once.

בְּנֵי takes the supplied *the* of *the Egyptians* while the gentilic absorbs its lexeme. The competing reading fuses בְּנֵי מִצְרַיִם into one unit under rule 30, as with דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים → *chronicles*; the chapter is at least internally consistent, treating בְּנֵי אַשּׁוּר the same way at 16.28.

*provoke ... to anger* keeps its head on *provoke*, which is a lexical verb rather than a light verb; rule 44's *put to shame* precedent would push the head to *anger*, so this is the reading taken, not the only one available.
